tags.description: A multi-mission vessel, capable of performing search and rescue, law enforcement, fishery patrols, drug interdiction, illegal immigrant interdiction, and homeland security duties up to 200 miles offshore.
tags.name: Patrol Boat Pier

tags.description: The Coast Guard 45-foot Response Boat Medium is a fast and maneuverable craft for search and rescue; law enforcement; drug and migrant interdiction; and National Defense Operations. Max speed: 43 knots, Range: 250 nautical miles.
tags.name: 45 RBM

tags.description: The 33-foot law enforcement special purpose craft is a multi-mission craft designed and built primarily for counter-drug and migrant missions along the U.S. maritime border. This boat is the first joint acquisition with U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
tags.name: 33 SPC-LE

tags.description: The Coast Guard 29-foot Response Boat Small is designed year-round operation in waters along coastal borders for port and waterway security, search and rescue, drug and migrant interdiction, National Defense missions, and environmental protection.
tags.name: 29 RBS
